response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a highly experienced, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and infrastructure domains, but his profile does not match this Director-level Principal Engineer AI Strategy role. His career track shows Senior/Staff Developer titles rather than principal/strategic leadership, his AI exposure is limited to a brief recent mention of MCP tooling and agentic frameworks, and there's no evidence of the required strategic customer advisory work, recognized AI expertise, or demonstrated AI products/platforms at scale.
strengths: Nearly two decades of diverse engineering experience spanning web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure systems
Demonstrated ability to learn and apply many languages/stacks (TypeScript, DLang, C/C++, Java, Swift) across varied domains
Some recent hands-on exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflow tooling
concerns: No advanced degree or demonstrated deep expertise in AI/ML; AI experience is recent and shallow relative to role expectations
Career trajectory shows Senior/Staff Developer roles, not Principal/Director-level strategic or leadership positions
No evidence of advising strategic customers/partners on cloud or AI adoption, or of driving cross-org technical strategy

key_factors.factor: Seniority/title mismatch with Director-level Principal role
